# Flagpack v0.6.0 - Table of Contents

Provides 4x3 country flags as Phoenix.Component. Based on flagpack.

## Modules

- [Flagpack](https://flagpack.hexdocs.pm/Flagpack.md): Provides 4x3 country flags as `Phoenix.Component`. Based on [flagpack.xyz](https://flagpack.xyz/).
- [Flagpack.Helpers](https://flagpack.hexdocs.pm/Flagpack.Helpers.md)
